plan.goal: Generate a single small soluble de novo protein candidate via unconditional backbone diffusion, inverse folding, structure prediction, QC, and ranking.
assumptions: Unconditional backbone generation is sufficient for a targetless soluble protein design.
A single backbone and one inverse-folded sequence is adequate for a compact workflow.
ESM3 sequence-to-structure provides sufficient structural evidence without a separate folding step.
Solubility is approximated by GRAVY, instability index, and pI QC metrics alongside pLDDT confidence.
